column1: # Circuit designs REDSTONEPEDIA does not publish: they stay in the repository's archives (research,
# the judge's history) but get no card, page, search hit, count or download on the site. One line
# each: <study>/<archived file pattern, * = any text> TAB <why>; `*/@<class>` hides every design of a
# class (its verdict's axis, e.g. `L = 10 gt, vibration-sensitive`). A line starting with `!` is an
# exception: a design it matches is published whatever the other lines say. Read by
# crates/site/src/circuits.rs (`hidden_design`); `mctas site smoke` checks that none is published;
# `mctas site build` lists the dominated designs still published (`mctas site dominated`).
